svg.desc: All curves approach Z equals 1 at low pressure. CO2 has a deeper attraction-driven dip than CH4. H2 rises approximately linearly above 1 over this model range. At high pressure, volume and repulsive effects raise Z. The dashed horizontal ideal-gas line is Z equals 1.
svg.title: CH4, CO2 and H2 compressibility-factor curves at the same temperature
